title: PERSONA: A Reproducible Testbed for Pluralistic Alignment
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the ability of language models to generate responses that align with synthetic personas. Religion is one of the demographic attributes used to define these personas, influencing their values and preferences on a diverse set of topics.
findings: The influence of religion was measured as part of a larger set of attributes. The 'Leave-One-Out Analysis' showed that religion is an influential attribute in shaping a persona's preferences, with an effect size comparable to ideology and political views. However, the study found that no single attribute, including religion, overpowers the others, highlighting its role as part of a complex, holistic persona profile for alignment testing.
